About

I am Tanjil Ahmed, an educator and professional facilitator based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. I currently serve as an English and Art of Living Facilitator at Daffodil Polytechnic Institute, where I design and deliver language development programs that go beyond the classroom — focusing on communication confidence, emotional resilience, and real-world readiness. I also serve as Adviser to the Institute's Debate Club, mentoring students in structured argumentation and public speaking.

I hold a Bachelor of Arts in English Language and Literature from Daffodil International University, graduating with a CGPA of 3.58 out of 4.00. My academic and professional journey has been shaped by a deep belief that language is not just a subject — it is a bridge between individuals, communities, and opportunities.
